name: Head Start
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Chaos Theory: Wünderkind, the Revised Core Set's Shaper identity, one more [mu] on a forty-card deck, and Dinosaurus, the console that hosts one non-AI icebreaker outside the memory limit at +2 strength. Two Dinosaurus and three Dyson Mem Chip, memory and link, around three Shaper breakers to host — Gordian Blade, Battering Ram and Pipeline — Self-modifying Code to find them, and the money and runs of the Shaper Sweep decks. In faction throughout. Eternal-legal only: Chaos Theory is a Revised Core Set card. FFG F1 Stage 1.
